findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - The release pull request passes its configured CI checks.
The proof list names the guide suite, but the PR workflow runs `forge test --change` at `.github/workflows/forge.yml:88`. The selector at `src/forge/fasttest.py:392` does not select this unchanged suite for the release diff, and `.forge/always-tests.txt` does not list it. The separate plugin job runs other tests. The PR can therefore pass without running this named proof. Include the guide suite in the PR check.
Adds work: run the named guide suite in PR CI; F 1 x H 2 = 2; 2 x C = 2
